rationale: The current topology suffers from poor input match (S11) due to insufficient input impedance matching, as indicated by the highly negative normalized margin. The binding constraint is S11_max_db, with the measured S11 at -0.52 dB, far from the -8 dB requirement. The primary issue lies in the lack of a proper input impedance transformation network—specifically, the absence of a series inductor or shunt capacitor to tune the input impedance toward 50 Ω. Introducing a small series inductor at the input (between VIN1 and the gate node) enables resonant tuning of the input impedance to improve S11, while maintaining the inductorless-class relaxation and minimal device count. This is a minimal yet effective fix that targets the most negative margin without perturbing other metrics.
